jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Implementation Manager

Continuum · Reports to the Director of Implementation
Continuum is hiring an Implementation Manager to own the customer journey from technical discovery through configuration, UAT, production deployment, and adoption. You will lead implementations spanning Continuum, customer ERP environments, vendor systems, APIs, and operational workflows, translating supply chain business requirements into technical solutions.

You own both the implementation and the solutioning. This is not a project coordination or onboarding role.

You will report to the Director of Implementation and act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, owning the lifecycle from technical discovery through post-implementation support. The role moves quickly and the product continues to evolve, so you will need to adapt, prioritize, and communicate clearly as conditions change.

To apply, complete the required Culture Index assessment:
https://go.cultureindex.com/s/oxjbISXCN8

What you’ll own

•    Lead technical discovery with customers to map business processes, ERP workflows, and integration requirements.
•    Translate supply chain business requirements into technical solutions — data mapping, business rules, and configuration logic.
•    Build the implementation plan for each customer, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, and resource allocation.
•    Configure Continuum to customer specifications and integrate with customer ERP environments, vendor systems, and APIs.
•    Own UAT end to end: build test cases, run the testing cycle, triage defects, and drive to sign-off.
•    Run production deployment and drive adoption after go-live.
•    Meet or exceed implementation deadlines, and escalate risk before it impacts delivery.
•    Coordinate with software developers, QA analysts, and customer support throughout delivery.
•    Maintain strong written documentation — SOPs, technical requirements, process docs, and UAT plans — and keep precise notes and account details in Jira.
•    Manage stakeholders from executive and IT through operations and end users.
•    Run regular status meetings to share progress, address concerns, and gather feedback.
•    Lead user training so customers can use the product effectively.
•    Serve as the primary point of contact for post-implementation support: resolve inquiries, troubleshoot issues, identify root cause, and escalate when needed.
•    Pivot and prioritize across multiple concurrent accounts while keeping timelines and expectations in scope.
•    Evaluate and improve implementation processes to increase efficiency and scalability.
•    Work with sales and account management to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage.

What we’re looking for

•    3+ years in technical implementation, solutions consulting, ERP implementation, or technical project management.
•    End-to-end ownership of complex technical implementations or integrations.
•    Direct experience with ERP systems and ERP integrations.
•    Business process mapping and technical solutioning.
•    Multiple concurrent projects across different stakeholders and technical environments.
•    Stakeholder management from executive and IT through operations and end users.
•    Strong written documentation — SOPs, technical requirements, process docs, UAT plans.
•    Experience leading discovery, UAT, training, rollout, and adoption.
•    Works to tight deadlines and escalates risk before it impacts delivery.
•    Experience working directly with a development team throughout delivery.
•    Clear communication across customers, internal teams, and stakeholders at every level.
•    Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work through ambiguity.
•    Understanding of manufacturing and distribution workflows and the operational challenges these customers face.
•    Fluency with Jira, HubSpot, and Claude.

Technical fluency

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be technically fluent enough to hold a working conversation with IT teams and developers. You should be comfortable discussing:
•    ERP architecture and integrations
•    APIs and system-to-system communication
•    Data mapping and field mapping
•    Transaction and workflow dependencies
•    Sandbox vs. production environments
•    ERP order, return, purchasing, inventory, and credit processes
•    Business rules and configuration logic
•    UAT methodology and test-case development
•    Integration testing and troubleshooting
•    Root-cause identification and escalation

Strong signals

Not required, but these stand out:
•    ERP platforms: Epicor Eclipse, Epicor Prophet 21 (P21), NetSuite, CSD / Infor, or comparable enterprise ERP.
•    Industries: distribution, wholesale, manufacturing, HVAC, industrial supply, logistics, or other supply-chain-heavy environments.
•    Workflow domains: returns, warranties, replacement orders, credits, inventory, vendor returns, receiving, purchasing.
•    Downstream thinking: treats an ERP transaction as more than a technical event, and understands the impact on inventory, warehouse operations, purchasing, AP, AR, and customer and vendor credits.

What we’re not looking for

This role is probably not the right fit if your experience is:
•    Non-technical SaaS onboarding.
•    Customer Success or Account Management without implementation ownership.
•    Project coordination or project management focused on schedules and task tracking.
•    Training and adoption without integration or systems experience.
•    Implementations where another team defined the requirements and the solution.

Who thrives in this role

Someone who can walk into an unfamiliar supply chain operation, understand how the business and the ERP work together, translate what needs to change into a technical solution, align stakeholders, and drive the organization into production and adoption against an aggressive deadline.
Technically curious. Operationally minded. Highly organized. Comfortable with ambiguity. Strong with customers. Relentless about execution.

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

Job Description

How Do You Fit In?

At Fabletics, we believe AI is transforming how work gets done. As our AI Project Manager, you’ll help turn that potential into reality.

You’ll partner with teams across the business to uncover opportunities where AI can eliminate friction, improve productivity, and enable smarter ways of working. From the first conversation through pilot, rollout, and adoption, you’ll help move ideas into measurable business impact.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, technology, and change management. You’ll spend as much time understanding people and processes as you will testing new AI tools and workflows.

We’re looking for a builder, not just a coordinator.

Someone who sees a problem and instinctively starts figuring out how to solve it. Someone who enjoys experimenting, learns quickly, takes ownership, and isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. You don’t wait for perfect direction. You create clarity from ambiguity, connect the right people, and keep momentum moving.

You don’t need to be an AI expert on day one. Tools can be taught. What matters most is curiosity, initiative, creativity, and the drive to experiment, connect dots, and turn messy problems into better ways of working.

This position reports to the AI Program Director.

What You’ll Do

Partner with business teams to understand how work gets done today and identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value.
Lead AI initiatives from discovery through pilot, rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Transform ambiguous ideas into clear project plans, priorities, timelines, owners, and actionable next steps.
Help keep the AI program organized by managing priorities, tracking initiatives, and ensuring work moves forward across multiple projects.
Develop executive-ready updates, dashboards, presentations, and status reports that communicate the impact, progress, and priorities of the AI team.
Track priorities, dependencies, risks, blockers, decisions, and key milestones to keep projects and the overall AI roadmap on track.
Stay flexible as business needs evolve, helping the AI team reassess priorities, adapt plans, and shift focus when higher-impact opportunities emerge.
Experiment with AI tools, prompts, agents, automations, and emerging technologies to identify practical business applications.
Design and improve workflows that help teams work faster, smarter, and more effectively.
Build and maintain playbooks, documentation, communications, and operating processes that help scale the AI function across the business.
Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, project updates, and training that drive alignment and adoption.
Partner with IT, Security, and Learning & Development to support responsible AI governance, education, and enterprise adoption.
Share best practices, lessons learned, and emerging opportunities that help scale AI across Fabletics.

What You Bring

2+ years of experience in project management, operations, consulting, business transformation, product, or another fast-paced environment.
A proven ability to bring structure to ambiguity and move ideas from concept to execution.
A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You naturally jump into problems, figure things out, and drive progress without waiting to be asked.
Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to simplify complex ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
A curious, growth-oriented mindset. You enjoy learning, experimenting, and continuously improving.
Good instincts for when to add structure, when to keep things lightweight, and how to keep work moving without overcomplicating it.
A practical approach to AI. You care less about hype and more about solving real business problems and delivering measurable outcomes.
Ideal candidate brings foundational AI literacy, including experience using generative AI tools, and a proactive mindset to experiment with new technologies to drive productivity and innovation.

Nice to Have

Experience with AI tools, automation, workflow design, digital transformation, or business process improvement.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI agents, low-code automation, or emerging workplace technologies.
Experience leading workshops, change management, or organizational adoption initiatives.
Experience creating playbooks, process maps, dashboards, executive presentations, or training materials.
Experience working across technical, operational, and business teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

This isn’t a traditional project management role.

You’ll help shape how AI transforms one of the world’s leading digitally native retail brands. Every week you’ll solve new business problems, experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate with teams across the company, and help define the future of how work gets done at Fabletics.

If you’re energized by solving problems, building from scratch, connecting people, and turning ideas into real impact, you’ll thrive here.

Post Title:
Intelligence Analyst

Contract type:
Fixed Term Contract until 31st March 2029

Rank/grade:
D

Salary: Starting
Salary £37,190 + £6,920 London Weighting (Pay award Pending)

Directorate/department:
Domestic Corruption Unit, National Lead Force

Bishopsgate Police Station

Vetting level required: MV/SC
(find out more here- https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels)

The City of London Corporation is currently undergoing a programme to ensure that our pay and reward practices are competitive and equitable across the whole organisation to ensure that everyone has the opportunity to thrive in the work that we do.

Who are we?

As City of London Police, we protect the people, businesses and infrastructure of the City of London, one of the most important and dynamic environments in the UK and globally. London City is the smallest borough in London, so does that make our job any less challenging? Absolutely not – because there’s so much going on.

City of London Police play a vital role in keeping the City of London diverse community safe. As a Police Staff Member you will be helping to making the city safer and deliver a valued service for those that live, work and visit the City.

Hybrid working -
This Police Staff role adheres to Corporation of London’s hybrid working policy, which requires a 60% office attendance rate. The specifics of this will be discussed locally with your hiring manager if you’re successful for the role.

The City of London Police is keen to promote flexible working and will, subject to operational policing requirements, proactively consider all applications to work flexibly.

The City of London Police is committed to equality of opportunities and continuously strive for inclusivity within our Force.

About The Team

The Domestic Corruption Unit (DCU), serves as the national coordinating function for domestic bribery and corruption in support of His Majesty's Government's Anti-Corruption Strategy. The unit receives and assesses referrals from police forces, public sector organisations, partner agencies, and private industry, undertaking triage and development work to determine investigative viability, threat, risk, and harm. Where appropriate, the DCU either conducts investigations directly or supports the allocation of matters to local forces, regional organised crime units, or other partner agencies, while providing ongoing specialist advice and oversight.

In addition to its investigative role, the DCU works closely with national partners, including the Joint Anti-Corruption Unit (JACU) and the National Economic Crime Centre (NECC), to improve understanding of the domestic corruption threat and identify systemic vulnerabilities. The unit also has a strong focus on prevention and disruption, using intelligence and insight to identify emerging risks, strengthen institutional integrity, and support improvements in policy, practice, and capability across policing and partner organisations, thereby enhancing the UK's overall response to domestic bribery and corruption.

NLF ONLY:
You can find out more about working within National Lead Force here- https://vimeo.com/1124775531/c2ea98aee0?share=copy

About The Role

The Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for providing dedicated analytical support to the Domestic Corruption Unit (DCU) in understanding the domestic corruption threat and in the investigation of bribery, corruption, money laundering, and associated criminality.

The candidate will be responsible for the production of crime and intelligence products in line with the National Intelligence Model (NIM). The candidate will be expected to identify and develop enforcement, disruption and prevention opportunities through analysis. Findings will be utilised by the DCU, wider law enforcement and the counter corruption community to disrupt and prevent criminals from committing bribery and corruption. The role would benefit from a candidate with good analytical experience in supporting investigations who is able to operate effectively from the outset.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be:

Collate, evaluate and analyse information from a variety of internal and external sources, producing high quality analytical products, contributing to the development of strategies and identification of enforcement, disruption and prevention opportunities.
Applying analytical techniques, to develop crime and intelligence packages, compliant with the NIM for dissemination to law enforcement and the wider counter corruption community.
As appropriate, to maximise intelligence sharing opportunities to develop the unit’s capability, as well as informing stakeholder initiatives/strategies.
Conduct evidential analysis and attend court to give evidence.
Undertake any other duties commensurate with the role and grade as reasonably requested by line management.

Requirements

Your application will be scored against the criteria listed below for shortlisting. Please give examples and evidence your ability, knowledge and experience against the points below in your application.

Excellent research and analytical skills to identify the required information to facilitate accurate assessments of bribery and corruption.
Excellent report writing skills to provide key information in relation to the assessment decision that is both clear and auditable.
Good decision-making skills and the ability to communicate decisions to stakeholder groups and effectively manage their expectations.
Previous experience of working as an analyst within a law enforcement or associated public/private sector organisation.
A proven analytical background, together with knowledge of criminal investigations, practices and processes.

This vacancy is open only to those who have the right to work in the UK.
Due to security vetting requirements for this being MV/SC, applicants must have continuously resided in the UK for the 5 years immediately preceding their application. Unfortunately, we are unable to progress applications that do not meet this requirement.

If you would like to discuss the role please contact: Kayleigh Peters at Kayleigh.peters@cityoflondon.police.uk.

Selection Process

As part of the initial application process, you will be asked to evidence how your experience, skills, and knowledge align with the points listed above in the ‘Requirements Section.’

The application and interview will be tested under Level 2 of the College of Policing Competency and Values Framework.

Applicants who fail to address the skills/knowledge/experience of the job description will not be considered.

The closing date for applications is 7th September 2026 @ 23:59
(we reserve the right to close this campaign early and without notice if we receive a high volume of applications).

Following shortlisting, successful candidates will be invited to attend a competency-based interview, to commence from 21st September 2026.

We strive to ensure all our information and services are accessible to and useable by everyone. If you would like to receive any information in a different way, would like us to do anything differently to help you apply for our roles, or have any other questions, please get in touch with HR via
hrservices@cityoflondon.police.uk

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Technology Operations Analyst serves as the business-facing operational lead for Deployment Solutions IT. This role owns request intake, governance administration, process design, documentation, onboarding readiness, knowledge management, change management, training coordination, and adoption. The position turns Deployment Solutions business needs into clear requirements, repeatable processes, documented playbooks, and measurable adoption outcomes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Governance And Intake Management

Own and maintain the Deployment Solutions IT request intake model for enhancements, client customizations, support process improvements, and onboarding needs.
Facilitate prioritization, routing, decision tracking, and follow-up for Deployment Solutions IT requests.
Maintain governance artifacts including intake logs, decision logs, action items, readiness checklists, and process documentation.

Process Design And Documentation

Design and document repeatable Deployment Solutions IT processes, SOPs, how-to guides, playbooks, and support procedures. Including assessment of legacy workflows and implementation of modern operating models leveraging AI-enabled capabilities, automation frameworks, and knowledge-driven solutions.
Partner with application and technical analysts to convert recurring support issues into reusable knowledge content.
Maintain Deployment Solutions IT knowledge resources, resource hub content, and ServiceNow support content.

Client Onboarding And Readiness

Facilitate technology requirements gathering for new client onboarding and client-driven changes.
Coordinate onboarding readiness reviews, handoffs, communication needs, and support transition activities.
Ensure onboarding documentation captures relevant policies, workflows, limits, audit needs, reporting needs, extracts, and integration dependencies.

Change Management And Adoption

Develop communication plans, training plans, launch readiness materials, and adoption support for Deployment Solutions technology changes.
Measure usage, adoption, feedback, and self-service effectiveness.
Support stakeholder engagement across Deployment Solutions, IT, compliance, finance, project teams, and end users.
Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
All other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB

Travel 0-10%, as business needs require.
Full-time role; standard work week with periodic flexibility for implementation support, client onboarding, or offshore coordination.

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, operations, communications, healthcare administration, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
5+ years of experience in technology business analysis, operations, change management, client onboarding, service delivery, process improvement, or application management operations.
3+ years of experience documenting processes, facilitating requirements, managing stakeholder communications, and coordinating UAT or readiness activities.
5+ years of experience demonstrating strong written communication, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
3+ years of experience with Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and process documentation tools

Experience working with offshore teams, shared service models, managed services providers, or distributed support organizations.
Experience supporting cross-functional initiatives involving IT, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and client-facing teams.
Experience supporting client-facing service delivery environments with competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
Experience participating in software implementations, technology deployments, or organizational change initiatives.

CORE SUCCESS MEASURES

Request intake cycle time and prioritization throughput.
Percentage of key Deployment Solutions IT processes documented and approved.
Knowledge article usage, self-service utilization, and ticket deflection trends.
Onboarding readiness completion and reduction in rework.
User adoption, training completion, and stakeholder satisfaction.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

Patient Minded

Take Action

About Truespeed

At Truespeed, we’re on a mission to transform broadband across the UK. We’re a rapidly growing full-fibre broadband provider, bringing reliable, high-speed connectivity to communities across the South West, North West and South East of England
.

We’re building our own full-fibre network and are passionate about delivering a better experience for our customers and the communities we serve. As we continue to grow, data is becoming increasingly important in helping us understand our customers, improve our services and make smarter decisions.

We’re looking for someone who can help us turn that data into meaningful insight and real business impact.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Data Analyst
to join our growing Analytics team and help shape how we use data across the business.

You’ll be part of our Retail Analytics squad
, working closely with teams across our two retail brands, Truespeed and Lila Connect
. You’ll play an important role in helping us attract, serve and retain customers, using data to understand performance, identify opportunities and support better decision-making.

This is a role with plenty of variety and ownership. You could be building a Power BI dashboard that gives a team instant visibility of performance, exploring a dataset to uncover an opportunity, or working with stakeholders to answer an important business question.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just report what
the data says, but wants to understand why it matters and what we should do about it
.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll have the opportunity to make a real difference across the business. Your work will include:

Building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and self-serve reporting, helping teams understand performance and make confident decisions.
Using data to investigate business challenges, identify trends and uncover opportunities to improve performance.
Writing SQL and using dbt to build and maintain robust data models.
Taking ownership of analytical work from the initial business question through to recommendation, delivery and measurement of impact.
Working with stakeholders to understand their challenges and identify the best data, tools and approaches to solve them.
Proactively exploring our data to uncover insights that could make a real difference to our customers and the business.
Working with data owners and engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
Helping shape requirements for new data pipelines and data feeds that enable better reporting and deeper insight.
Facilitating workshops and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Turning complex analysis into clear, engaging and actionable insights.
Helping us build a stronger data-driven culture by encouraging teams to use data in their everyday decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is curious, analytical and commercially minded, with the confidence to work with people across the business.

You’ll Ideally Bring

2+ years’ experience in a Data Analyst or similar analytical role.
Experience creating interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.
Strong SQL skills.
Experience with Python would be advantageous.
Excellent Excel skills and good working knowledge of PowerPoint.
A strong understanding of data modelling, including data grain, relationships, dimensional models and reusable metrics.
The ability to take complex data and turn it into simple, compelling and actionable insights.
Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with a wide range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
The ability to manage competing priorities and balance planned analytical work with urgent and ad hoc requests.
A commercial mindset and the ability to connect analysis to customer outcomes, operational performance and financial impact.
A curious and proactive approach – you’ll naturally want to ask questions, challenge assumptions and find out what the data is really telling us.
The ability to work at pace, make decisions and take ownership of your work.
Knowledge of the telecoms sector is desirable, but definitely not essential.
Right to work in the UK.

Why Join Truespeed?

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply produce reports and hand them over. We want our analysts to be trusted partners to the business

You’ll join a collaborative Analytics team where you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud data technologies, develop your analytical skills and see the direct impact of your work.

As Truespeed continues to grow, there’s plenty of opportunity to make your mark, take ownership and help shape how we use data across the business.

Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a hands-on, technical candidate to be the driver of our production data systemization and simulation efforts. As a member of the team, this candidate will operate at the intersection of manufacturing operations, data, and strategy and will be responsible for scoping, conceptualizing, and implementing high impact tools that drive factory operations.

You will act as a translator between functional groups and leadership, partnering with cross functional stakeholders (Factory Data Acquisition, Data, Software, and Operations) to turn messy systems data into actionable insight. This is an applied, hands-on role that combines data architecture, analysis, and system design to make our operations measurable, predictable, and optimizable.

The Role

Partner with leadership to define, implement, and operationalize a measurement framework that translates raw data into structured parameters - revealing operational efficiency, quality, and financial insights.
Standardize our inputs/outputs across models to create continuity between forecasting, scheduling, cost, and pricing.
Extend, tune, and maintain a discrete-event simulation that drives factory performance, forecasts demand, and simulates factory scaling scenarios.
Prototype 0 to 1 parameterized data models and internal tools - including optimization tools, state machines, dashboards and simulation models that drive behavior across floor level operators, managers and executives.
Collaborate with factory operations and engineering teams to identify tool gaps and scope and drive internal and external tool implementations.
Collaborate with factory data teams to identify data gaps and scope and drive projects to connect factory sensors, equipment, MES, ERP, and other operational systems.
Drive projects through discovery, requirement definition, data backed proposal, functional prototyping, and formal implementation - including business case modeling and ROI justification for internal or external tool investments.
Conduct a broad range of ad-hoc analysis spanning from process efficiency to complex scenario analyses that inform scheduling, staffing, and investment decisions.
Create presentations, visual workflows, diagrams, and prototypes to communicate complex problems clearly and align stakeholders in a common direction.
Clean, validate, and prepare data for analysis and simulation.
Document systems, pipelines, and assumptions clearly to enable scaling.

Basic Qualifications

Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering, Data Science, Data Analytics, Operations Research, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Demonstrated experience in data analytics, process improvement, or similar roles
Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, data pipelines, APIs, light scripting)
Strong proficiency in SQL and relational data modeling
Experience in front-end HTML development and web hosting
Demonstrated ability to perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis, basic statistics, and visualization
Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing terminology and operational data modeling (cycle time, yield, throughput)

Demonstrated competency with UI/workflow visualization tools (Figma, Illustrator, Visio)
Strong experience with presentation/organizational tools (Microsoft Suite, Atlassian Suite, Project Management Software, Smartsheet)

Strong presentation and oral skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences for stakeholders internal and external to the organization
Ability to translate messy and emergent business challenges into structured problem statements
Focus on detail, iterative design, human centered design, and systems thinking
Comfortable in a fast paced, dynamic environment
Ability to lean on and implement AI tools into daily workflow

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a start-up, consulting, or similar high-growth, fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
Experience interfacing with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand system designs and the associated constraints
Experience interpreting engineering drawings and CAD
Familiarity with basic financial concepts and modeling
Familiarity with MES/ERP/SCADA (OPC-UA, MTConnect, MES/ERP systems, Splunk, InfluxDB)

Vendor Management

Oversees study vendors throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring delivery of services in accordance with project timelines, scope, quality expectations, and budget.
Acts as the primary point of contact for assigned vendors and facilitates effective communication between vendors, Sponsors, and internal project teams.

Tracks vendor metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs), providing updates to Sponsors and internal stakeholders as required.
Contributes to maintaining positive vendor relationships while ensuring vendors meet contractual obligations and project performance expectations.

Why this role exists

Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative initiatives that span branding, campaigns, websites, digital experiences, content production, and marketing. They need more than someone who manages timelines. They need a proactive project leader who can create structure, align teams, coordinate resources, communicate with confidence, and keep creative work moving efficiently from the first client conversation through final delivery.

What you will be doing:

Lead creative projects end-to-end
- Own multiple creative initiatives across branding, campaigns, websites, digital experiences, content, and marketing projects, ensuring every phase moves forward with clarity, accountability, and momentum.
Turn business goals into actionable project plans
- Lead project kickoffs, clarify client objectives, define scope, establish realistic timelines, and create structured workflows that set Creative Directors and multidisciplinary teams up for success.
Guide the right creative team

What you will bring:

5+ years of relevant project management experience, including managing creative, branding, marketing, or digital projects within an agency or similar creative environment.

Experience leading multidisciplinary creative and marketing teams while coordinating priorities across multiple concurrent projects.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
CRB's over 1,100 expert professionals drive innovative, life-changing and life-saving solutions for manufacturers in the life sciences and food and beverage industries. Our mission, vision, and core values put client satisfaction and employee experience at the center of everything we do.

As an AEC Firm we proudly specialize in industries that inherently carry important social responsibility - we recognize our impact and influence in the communities we serve and pursue corporate responsibility through the lens of people, community, and planet. From oncology and rare disorders to COVID-19 or alternative proteins, our design and construction projects are pioneering solutions addressing important issues such as food scarcity and global health.

Job Description

The Design Project Manager
will lead multidisciplinary design teams in delivering innovative, compliant, and efficient facility solutions for clients in the life sciences, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical sectors. This role is pivotal in ensuring design excellence, client satisfaction, and seamless integration between architecture, engineering, and construction.

Location:
Remote option available - open to Savannah, GA, Tampa, FL, Miami, FL, Orlando, FL, Tallahassee, FL

Responsibilities

Project Leadership:
Manage the design phase of complex facility projects from concept through construction documentation, ensuring alignment with client goals, regulatory requirements, and CRB’s quality standards.
Client Engagement:
Serve as the primary design liaison with clients, facilitating clear communication, managing expectations, and ensuring satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
Team Coordination:
Lead and coordinate internal design teams (architects, engineers, consultants) and external partners to deliver integrated solutions on schedule and within budget.
Scope & Budget Management:
Define project scope, develop design budgets, and monitor progress to ensure financial and operational targets are met.
Regulatory Compliance:
Ensure all designs meet applicable codes, standards, and industry regulations, including GMP, FDA, and EU Annex 1 requirements.
Innovation & Sustainability:
Promote the use of cutting-edge technologies and sustainable design practices, including CFD modeling, energy-efficient systems, and modular construction strategies.
Risk Management:
Identify design risks early and implement mitigation strategies to avoid delays or cost overruns.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of experience in design project management, preferably in pharmaceutical or biotech facility design.
Strong understanding of GMP, cleanroom design, and regulatory environments.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in design software (Bluebeam, Navisworks) and project management platforms.

Additional Qualifications

PMP or similar project management certification.
Familiarity with progressive contracting and integrated project delivery (IPD) models.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_jobs.title: Senior Transmission Line Project Manager - Remote
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Senior Transmission Line Project Manager for our Power & Energy Management Team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical, schedules, quality, and financial aspects of Power and Energy Transmission Line projects, managing and developing client relationships, and marketing WSP’s Power Delivery services to existing and new clients, particularly in the South and Southwest Region. This position will be based out of Overland Park, KS, Ann Arbor, MI, Appleton, WI, Madison, WI, Minneapolis, WI Plover, WI or Saint Louis, MO with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Transmission Line projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and EHV Transmission Line projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
May participate, and at times, lead the contract negotiations and client presentations
Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan, as applicable.
Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.
Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market.
12+years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and/or extra high voltage transmission line type projects.
Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
Contract Management
External and Internal Team Meeting Management
Earned Value Management
Change Management
Risk Management
Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
Financial Management

Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

AMSOIL INC. is seeking a dedicated and experienced Project Manager, Customer Solutions to join our team. This position is responsible for maintaining strong positive relationships with customers through project management, equipment installation services, and ongoing preventative and repair maintenance of lubricant storage solutions. This position allows for a remote work schedule from a home office located in Wisconsin with travel by car or plane up to 60% of the time.

Core Responsibilities:

Management of Equipment Solutions for AMSOIL Customers (60%)
Identify and manage vendors for equipment supply options for storage, transfer, and containment of AMSOIL products.
Project management for customer-related equipment needs, from design support through customer approval.
Be on-site for all equipment installations, perform installation services where possible, and oversee 3rd party installers as required.
Manage detailed records of equipment installations.
Respond to customer needs related to equipment for preventative maintenance, repair, and replacement.
Perform equipment repairs as required at customer sites.

Management of 3rd Party Delivery Service Partners (30%)
Identify 3rd party distribution partners for effective delivery of AMSOIL products to support OEM, Industrial, and Private Label customers.
Participate in the negotiation of delivery fees and contract agreements.
Perform periodic on-site inventory audits at stocking distributor locations.
Facilitate monthly inventory reconciliation activities with all distribution partners.
Troubleshoot delivery problems and recommend solutions for recurring delivery issues.
Represent AMSOIL professionally in all partner relationships.

Continuous Improvement (10%)
Monitor and optimize customer delivery programs to increase reliability, control costs, and deliver overall improvement in the supply systems.
Report to division leadership on project status, performance KPIs of partners, and strategies for the future.

Position Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job.
Minimum 3 years of mechanical experience in a manufacturing or field service environment.
Knowledge of lubricant storage solutions and legal requirements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and negotiating skills.
Ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language.
Proficient in Microsoft Office.
Understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
Highly self-motivated and directed.
Keen attention to detail.
Superior analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to motivate in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Willingness to travel by plane or car as needed (up to 60%).

Paid time off and paid holidays each year
Employee bonus program

Paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
Competitive health benefits

Employee discount on product

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead some of Uplight's most complex cross-functional initiatives. You'll partner with Product and Engineering leaders to drive programs that span multiple teams, technical dependencies, and competing priorities. As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs across product and engineering. You will work closely with Product Managers and engineering leads based in North America and India, coordinating across time zones to maintain program alignment and momentum. Success in this role requires effective collaboration with distributed teams, strong organizational instincts, and the judgment to know when to drive forward independently and when to escalate.

Familiarity with device integration patterns, telemetry pipelines, IoT systems, or demand response programs

Prior experience working with engineering teams in India or other international locations

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Position Summary

The Fundraising Program Manager plays an important role on KQED’s Membership team, supporting the planning and execution of on-air fundraising drives, year-round fundraising campaigns, and third-party programs. Reporting to the Director of On-Air Fundraising & Third-Party Programs, this position helps coordinate the many details required to keep campaigns organized, on schedule, and aligned across teams.

The role is responsible for managing campaign timelines, coordinating meetings and deliverables, tracking results, and supporting communication with internal and external partners. The Fundraising Program Manager also conducts research, gathers data, and helps identify trends and opportunities that can inform future fundraising efforts.

The ideal candidate brings mid-level experience in membership, fundraising strategy, nonprofit analytics, or public media, or a related field. They are highly organized, comfortable working with data, able to manage multiple projects at once, and excited to contribute ideas while learning from experienced fundraising leaders. This is a role for someone who is genuinely energized by the question of what’s next in public media membership.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling.

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The Mission That Drives Us

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media. We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

Essential Functions

On-Air Fundraising Drive Operations & Campaign Execution

Serve as a primary operational partner to the Director across all on-air fundraising drives and year-round membership campaigns.
Own the radio spot schedule for drives: maintaining the master schedule, tracking production milestones, coordinating approvals, and ensuring spots are delivered on time and to spec.
Manage campaign timelines and internal project coordination - tracking deliverables, flagging risks, and keeping cross-functional stakeholders aligned throughout each drive.
Coordinate with vendors, freelancers, and production partners, ensuring external contributors have the assets, direction, and deadlines they need to deliver.
Maintain campaign documentation, production archives, and operational records for the Membership team.
Manage the testing and launch of each drive’s fundraising-free stream.
Support real-time monitoring during pledge drives, surfacing issues and escalating to the Director as needed to keep campaigns and gift challenges on track.

Membership Drive Analytics & Performance Reporting

Collaborate with the Data & Analytics team to ensure the right data is being captured, segmented, and surfaced for membership decision-making.
Manage dashboards and regular performance reports tracking key metrics across drives and year-round efforts.
Conduct post-campaign analysis following fundraising drives, identifying patterns, anomalies, and opportunities to test in future cycles.
Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insights the Director and broader team can act on, not just reporting what happened, but what it means.
Support the team with shared reporting and cross-channel performance analysis where audio and digital campaigns intersect.

Research, Strategy & Thought Partnership

Track emerging giving models and sector trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations that shape how KQED’s membership program evolves.
Monitor giving model innovation across public media and the broader nonprofit sector and benchmark KQED against peer organizations to identify gaps and opportunities.
Evaluate new strategies for organizational fit and feasibility, then produce strategy memos and recommendation briefs that equip the Director and VP of Membership to make decisions.
Serve as a thought partner to the Director, pressure-testing ideas, contributing to strategic planning, and bringing an external perspective to internal discussions.

Other Job Functions

Perform other duties as assigned.

Candidate Qualifications

Professional Background

4–6 years of experience in membership strategy, fundraising analytics, public media, nonprofit research, or a closely related field.
Demonstrated experience owning a research or analytical function and producing recommendations that influenced organizational strategy.
Experience providing operational or project coordination support in a campaign or fundraising environment.

Research, Strategy & Analytical Skills

Comfort working with donor or audience data: pulling reports, building dashboards, interpreting trends, and communicating findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write crisp research briefs, strategy memos, and presentation materials that move people to decisions.
Familiarity with CRM systems and donor data tools (ROI Solutions preferred) and experience with reporting or analytics platforms.

Collaboration & Ways of Working

Demonstrated ability to work effectively across teams, including with data, digital, programming, and product functions.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing sight of the big picture.

Mission Alignment

Genuine curiosity about the evolving landscape of nonprofit fundraising and enthusiasm for bringing new ideas into a mission-driven organization.
Deep commitment to the values and mission of public media and KQED’s role in serving diverse Bay Area communities.

Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach.
Fine motor skills; good visual and auditory acuity.

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon Healthcare Security (HealthSec), we are on a mission to make healthcare secure and easy. We are developing a patient centric healthcare experience that is personal, transparent, and convenient. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross organizational programs across our health portfolio.

As a Senior TPM, you are part of a global organization of security engineers, software developers, and technical program managers dedicated to continuously raising the security bar. We operate with an AI First mindset, leveraging generative AI and machine learning to scale security decisions, automate defenses, and move faster than emerging threats. You will own ambiguous, multi team initiatives end to end: defining program strategy, aligning engineering, science, legal, and product partners, and delivering measurable outcomes. You will operate at the intersection of security engineering, AI/ML, and healthcare regulation, translating fuzzy problems into crisp plans and shipping them.

Key job responsibilities

Own the lifecycle and strategy of large, complex, cross functional security programs across multiple engineering teams, from problem definition through launch and operational readiness.

Drive technical decisions and tradeoffs with engineering and applied science leaders, diving deep into architecture, threat models, and data handling design.

Build and manage program roadmaps, dependencies, and risk registers, proactively removing blockers.

Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to meet regulatory requirements such as HIPAA and related health data standards.

Champion an AI First approach, applying generative AI and automation to scale threat detection and accelerate reviews, while managing the risks AI systems introduce.

Author crisp narratives, including mechanism docs, program plans, and MBR and QBR content, for senior leadership.

Report on program metrics, tie outcomes to organization goals, contribute to OP1 and OP2 narratives, and define operational health for Tier 1 support.

Influence without authority across a VP organization, aligning senior managers, directors, and system owners with competing priorities.

Force multiply across teams, removing systemic blockers and driving simplification in engineering processes and architectures.

Eliminate excess process, creating predictable mechanisms and paths to green that raise the delivery bar.

Mentor and develop other program managers, and contribute to hiring and technical promotion assessments.

About The Team

The Amazon Healthcare Security (HealthSec) team safeguards the data, devices, and systems at the core of Amazon’s healthcare business. We own the security of highly sensitive protected health information (PHI) and the trust patients and customers place in us. We are an AI First team: we embed security and privacy by design, partner with builders early to prevent issues before they ship, and apply generative AI and automation to scale threat detection and stay ahead of a fast evolving threat landscape. We hold ourselves to a bar exceeding strict regulatory requirements, and measure success by risk reduced for patients.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

6+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in an advanced technical program, or 6+ years of technical work experience
Experience directly working with engineering teams

Experience with any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing
Experience with AI/ML technologies
Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs

new_jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Program & Project Management

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Location:
San Francisco/Palo Alto, CA or Bellevue/Seattle, WA

The Experience

Technical Program Managers (TPMs) play a meaningful role at Salesforce, leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives within our Technology & Products organizations. TPMs own programs from beginning to end, driving better workflow and more effective communication. They work closely with executives and key partners to move critical programs and activities forward across the company.

Senior Technical Program Managers in Trust & Infrastructure lead strategic technology programs that drive transformation to Hyperforce, Salesforce's infrastructure product built on third-party substrates like AWS and GCP. This person partners with program leadership teams to drive cross-functional and cross-domain planning and execution across multiple clouds — Engineering, Customer Enablement, Legal, and Product — to deliver key business value. This role has a specific mandate to elevate the developer experience across Trust & Infrastructure — ensuring every safety and compliance investment we make also removes friction and unlocks velocity for the engineers who build on our platform.

This is a fast-paced, dynamic environment with mission-critical deliverables and a steady stream of unforeseen challenges. Communication, coordination, organization, leadership, flexibility, and ownership are key to succeeding in this role. This is an individual contributor role suited to someone who thrives in a culture of ownership, delivery, and innovation.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive developer experience programs that pair safety/compliance requirements with measurable productivity gains — e.g., reducing time-to-merge, cutting manual toil, or improving self-service tooling adoption — so trust and velocity reinforce each other rather than trade off.
Partner with Developer Tools, Platform, and Engineering teams to identify and eliminate friction points in the inner/outer development loop, translating developer feedback into prioritized program roadmaps.
Lead programs by aligning on scope and release planning, uniting teams around vision and business goals, and securing cross-functional alignment.
Drive Steering Committee meetings with key partners to make decisions, remove obstacles, and address program issues, ensuring business goals are met.

You're Our Person If...

You have 8+ years of enterprise software/technical program or engineering management experience at an enterprise technology company.
You have 5+ years leading SaaS product development programs, with a demonstrated understanding of the SaaS business model and product development lifecycle.
You have deep experience with the software development lifecycle and can apply agile methodologies in a dynamic environment.
You have experience driving developer-facing programs or tooling initiatives, and you think in terms of developer experience metrics (adoption, cycle time, satisfaction) as much as program milestones.

Even Better If...

You have experience with Portfolio Management.
You can quickly master new technical subjects and technologies relevant to a program.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of hands-on, detail-oriented execution.
You've worked on programs balancing security/compliance mandates with developer productivity — you know how to make "safe" and "fast" the same thing, not a tradeoff.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? new_jobs.title: Aerospace Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Renaissance Services operates the “Rapid Cast Parts – Center of Excellence” where it provides small quantities of parts made from castings for sustaining legacy systems as well as helping to develop new systems. The customers include the US Air Force, Army, and Navy as well as multiple aerospace prime contractors.

As part of providing rapid cast parts, Renaissance addresses three key areas:
Reverse Engineering – Renaissance takes legacy parts that lack design data and creates the technical data package, including models, drawings, and specifications.
Additive Manufacturing - Renaissance uses ceramic additive manufacturing to create casting molds, greatly reducing the time and cost to create small quantities of castings.
Supply Chain Production – Renaissance works with its rapid casting network of multiple foundries and machining suppliers to produce the small quantity of parts.

Our team thrives on technical precision, uncompromising quality standards, and collaborative problem-solving. Are you passionate about program management and eager to work with innovative manufacturing solutions? Do you thrive on challenging conventional processes and delivering part production in a fast-paced environment? If so, Renaissance Services is looking for you.

We are seeking a Program Manager to join our team during an exciting phase of growth and transformation in aerospace & defense manufacturing. This is a dynamic opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on collaboration, continuous improvement, and making a tangible impact.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in precision casting (investment, sand, etc.), a firm grasp of aerospace and defense quality frameworks, and a proven track record of managing technical engineering programs on schedule and within budget. Must be a U.S. citizen.

Key Responsibilities

Program Lifecycle Management:
Own end-to-end program execution for aerospace and defense cast components, ensuring adherence to technical specifications, delivery schedules, and financial targets.
Customer Relationship Management:
Act as key point of contact for external clients, facilitating technical progress reviews, managing expectations, and providing proactive communication regarding schedule or scope adjustments.
Cross-Functional Leadership:
Coordinate internal engineering, quality, operations, and supply chain teams to streamline workflow bottlenecks and drive efficient manufacturing.
Risk & Change Management:
Identify technical, schedule, and quality risks early in the production cycle; develop and implement robust mitigation strategies.
Quality & Compliance Oversight:
Ensure all manufactured parts comply with rigorous industry standards (e.g., AS9100, CMMC, DCAA/FAR compliance, and customer-specific specifications).
Financial & Resource Tracking:
Monitor program budgets, track cost variances, manage billing milestones, and forecast resource allocation for upcoming production runs.

Key Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
Minimum of 5+ years of program or project management experience within the aerospace and defense manufacturing sector.
Demonstrated experience or technical familiarity with metal casting and/or machining processes (for aluminum, nickel, steel, magnesium).
Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems, ITAR regulations, and defense contract compliance.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and a detail-oriented mindset capable of balancing multiple fast-paced programs simultaneously.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) as well as usage of ERP systems and Project Management systems.

Other Job elements

Hybrid work schedule – part time from home, part time in the office/plant (typically Tues/Fri).
Up to 20% travel to customer or supplier sites.

Job Description

Program Manager

The Tulsa, Oklahoma Performance Center is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to execute all aspects of customer programs to ensure that all activities are carried out in accordance with technical and contractual requirements, schedules and budgets. The Program Manager is the focal point for the company for communications with the customer (internal / external) and is responsible to ensure customer requirements are flowed down to all functional departments.

Who are we?

Founded in 1849, Ducommun is the oldest company in California. Starting as a hardware supply store during the California Gold Rush and eventually assisted in the birth of the aerospace industry in Southern California by providing aircraft aluminum to early aerospace pioneers like Lindbergh, Douglas and Lockheed.

Today Ducommun is a global provider of innovative manufacturing solutions for customers in the aerospace, defense and industrial markets. We specialize in electronic and structural systems, producing complex products and components for commercial aircraft platforms, mission-critical military and space programs, and sophisticated industrial applications.

Our facility in Tulsa, Oklahoma manufactures state-of-art circuit cards for aerospace and defense applications.

Job Summary

Focal point for customer communication and interface:
Manages communications and relationships between Ducommun and its customers. Communication and tracking of customer scorecards and surveys.
Focal / Leader for the Integrated Product Team (IPT).
Represents the company in contacts with the customer and outside parties for all issues concerning the assigned program.
Provide timely notification to management and customer of program cost, quality or schedule impact.
Execution of New Product Introduction – Phase Gate Process.
Provide a coordinated company response to customer requirements (commercial – technical) and inquiries (voice of the customer).
Presentation of program reviews to Customer.
Internal Communication and interface:
Communicate within IPT to assure proper coordination of customer requirements (schedule, recovery plans, reports, etc.).
Ensure that the company's capabilities and business interests support customer requests.

Presentation of program reviews to Sr. Leadership.

Manage and track program compliance to purchase order requirements.
Prepare assertions and claims to customer in accordance to contract parameters.

Responsible to coordinate with Operations Management to review requirements for programs as they relate to Operational Performance, Staffing, IPT development, planning for capital expenditures / preventative maintenance
